item.title: Michael Phelps' $100M fortune in 2026: Endorsements, investments and luxury life
item.summary: Michael Phelps turned his legendary Olympic achievements into a multi-million dollar empire. By securing high-value endorsements from renowned brands post-retirement, he also channeled his success into impactful ventures. His establishment of a foundation showcases his commitment to youth education in swimming and healthy living. Additionally, Phelps's investment in the mental health platform shows his suppport for emotional wellness.
